item_person: Reinhold Christopher Müller (also Reinhold C. Mueller), born 1940; historian with the same LC, VIAF, GND and ISNI identifiers.

evidence.says: LC heading is Mueller, Reinhold C. Sources identify the author of Money and banking in medieval and Renaissance Venice and contributor to Descripcion ou traicte du gouvernement et regime de la cite et seigneurie de Venise (2015); the latter notes a Johns Hopkins PhD in 1969 and teaching medieval history at Ca’ Foscari in 1979–2008. LC links Q94783079, VIAF 17244058, GND 132708604 and ISNI 0000000110413982; the linked GND name is Mueller, Reinhold Christopher.

The item labels include Reinhold Christopher Müller and Reinhold Christopher Mueller; its French alias is Reinhold C. Mueller. It records historian (P106 Q201788), birth year 1940, LC n84018610, VIAF 17244058, GND 132708604, ISNI 0000000110413982 and BnF 12058631b.

BnF identifies Mueller, Reinhold Christopher (1940-....), gives birth year 1940 and describes a professor of medieval history at Università Ca’ Foscari, Venice, 1979–2008. It cites Studies in Venetian social and economic history, edited by Benjamin G. Kohl and Reinhold C. Mueller (1987), and lists the same VIAF and ISNI identifiers.
The graph’s supplied Open Library author ID has the name Reinhold C. Mueller.

This author’s works include Money and Banking in Medieval and Renaissance Venice: Volume I and Descripcion ou traicte du gouvernement et regime de la cite et seigneurie de Venise, both matching LC source titles, as well as The Venetian money market.
GND gives the preferred name Mueller, Reinhold Christopher, variants Mueller, Reinhold C. and Müller, Reinhold Christopher, and birth year 1940.

notes: The automatic name disagreement reflects expansion of C. to Christopher and the Müller/Mueller spelling variant. Matching works, affiliation and multiple identifiers establish the match. LC supplies no birth year; BnF supports Wikidata’s 1940.
